column6: eval (() => { const el = document.querySelector('[id*="404"]') || [...document.querySelectorAll('h1,h2,h3,h4')].find(h => h.textContent.includes('404')); return el ? el.tagName + ' | id=' + el.id + ' | text=' + el.textContent.trim() : 'not found'; })()

eval (() => { const els = document.querySelectorAll('h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6'); for (const el of els) { if (el.textContent.includes('404')) return el.tagName + ' | id=' + el.id + ' | text=' + el.textContent.trim(); } return 'not found in headings'; })()
